notes.title: Released a beta version of the multiplayer mode
notes.notes:
[h1]Added multiplayer mode[/h1].

Up until now, this game could only be played by one player, but prior to the release of Hole2, we've released a beta version of our multiplayer mode!

Starting with this update, you can compete with golfers from all over the world in real time, and laugh at your fallen opponents. (and vice versa, of course).

However, there is a limit to the number of players who can connect at the same time, and if there is a large number of connections, the game will be forced to go into solo mode as usual.

If you encounter any problems, please let me know on Twitter.
https://twitter.com/nattuhan

notes.title: Major bug fixes and a few additional features
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes[/b]
Fixed a problem where the number of clears and shots were not being counted correctly.

[b]Addition[/b]
Added a function to display the number of clears and shots on the home screen.
You can now reset the game by pressing the "R" key on your keyboard once you have cleared the game to save you from having to open the menu and press retry, which was the most stressful part of playing this game.
